description: Decimal / fractional quantity interception ('2.5 ctn' and '1,5kg') defensively downgraded to qty: null
rationale: Enforces H1 Rule 4 decimal guard. '2.5' hits the dot decimal guard '(?<![\d.,])\d+\.\d+(?![\d.,])', and '1,5kg' hits the comma decimal unit guard '(?<![\d.,])\d+,\s*\d+\s*(?:g|kg|ml|l|liter|litre|克|公斤|毫升|升)'. Both quantities are strictly set to null. Downstream OrderAiAdapter flags both lines as LOW_CONFIDENCE_MATCH with reason_code='INVALID_QUANTITY', preventing erroneous fractional wholesale orders.
